user.title: MVM smart meter
user.description: Choose a folder containing one meter's MVM semicolon-delimited CSV reports. New and overlapping reports in this folder are reconciled automatically. If your net balance resets annually, enter both rollover fields; otherwise leave both blank.

error.directory_not_found: The selected folder does not exist.
error.invalid_report: No valid measured MVM energy data was found. Check the CSV format and meter serial.
error.invalid_rollover_date: The annual rollover day is not valid for the selected month.
